title: Enhanced Selection Schedule for Combined Quantum Key Distribution Protocol
abstract: Designed an incrementally-biased Ry-based selection schedule for a hybrid GHZ-BB84 QKD architecture, achieving a 43.67% improvement in key-generation rate over a fixed 50/50 baseline.

title: Accelerating Noisy Quantum Circuit Simulation via Unitary Precomputation
abstract: Complete manuscript draft and research poster on accelerating noisy quantum circuit simulation techniques. Completed during the thesis phase of an intensive private research program at Mahdy Research Academy.
